title: Symmetric estimator for discrete self-energy of discrete many-body systems
summary: The self-energy is notoriously difficult to compute, especially in many-body systems with a discrete spectrum, where the Dyson equation often produces noncausal results. Here, the authors obtain a discrete spectral representation of the self-energy that is causal by construction, preserves sum rules, and requires no artificial broadening. Tested with four different impurity solvers, the approach significantly improves accuracy and enables a fully discrete formulation of dynamical mean-field theory.
